# First chapter, holding the marker

The marker is written here rather than in the last chapter: [Early]{.index}.

A term this chapter sorts one way and a later chapter sorts another. Each
chapter renders in its own process, so neither can see the other's key; the
book's records only meet where the index is built:
[Contested]{.index sort="Aaa"}.

A cross-reference whose target is marked in a LATER chapter. Nothing in this
chapter indexes `Late`, and this is the chapter that builds the index, so a
report drawn here would call a perfectly good target broken. It is drawn by
the last chapter in book order instead, which has seen every record:
[early reference]{.index entry="Early Reference" see="Late"}.
